items.full: Oppression by corporations is more of a concern than oppression by governments.

items.full: It is necessary for the government to intervene in the economy to protect consumers.

items.full: Taxes should be increased on the rich to provide for the poor.

items.full: Government intervention is a threat to the economy.

items.full: It is more important to retain peaceful relations than to further our strength.

items.full: A better world will come from automation, science, and technology.

items.full: Gun ownership should be prohibited for those without a valid reason.

items.full: It’s a sad reflection on our society that something as basic as drinking water is now a bottled, branded consumer product.

items.full: Protectionism is sometimes necessary in trade.

items.full: Taxpayers should not be expected to prop up any theatres or museums that cannot survive on a commercial basis.

items.full: The prime function of schooling should be to equip the future generation to find jobs.

items.full: What’s good for the most successful corporations is always, ultimately, good for all of us.

items.full: In a civilised society, one must always have people above to be obeyed and people below to be commanded.

items.full: The businessperson and the manufacturer are more important than the writer and the artist.

items.full: Almost all politicians promise economic growth, but we should heed the warnings of climate science that growth is detrimental to our efforts to curb global warming.

completions: OPPRESSION BY CORPORATIONS IS MORE OF A CONCERN THAN OPPRESSION BY THE GOVERNMENT.
IT IS NECESSARY FOR THE GOVERNMENT TO PROVIDE FOR THE COMMON GOOD.
TAXES SHOULD BE INCREASED ON THE WEALTHY TO FUND SOCIAL PROGRAMS.
GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION IS A NECESSARY EVIL IN A CAPITALIST SOCIETY.
THE UNITED NATIONS IS AN ESSENTIAL BODY FOR MAINTAINING INTERNATIONAL PEACE.
IT IS MORE IMPORTANT TO RETAIN INDIVIDUAL FREEDOMS THAN TO ENSURE SECURITY.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED AND HELD ACCOUNTABLE.
A BETTER WORLD WILL COME THROUGH COLLECTIVE ACTION AND COOPERATION.
TRADITIONS ARE OF NO VALUE IF THEY PERPETUATE INJUSTICE.
GUN OWNERSHIP SHOULD BE PROHIBITED TO REDUCE VIOLENCE.
IT’S A SAD REFLECTION ON OUR SOCIETY THAT SOMETHING AS BASIC AS HEALTHCARE IS NOT GUARANTEED.
PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO SAFEGUARD DOMESTIC INDUSTRIES.
TAXPAYERS SHOULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO PROP UP ANY FAILING BUSINESSES.
IT’S NATURAL FOR CHILDREN TO CHALLENGE AUTHORITY AND SEEK INDEPENDENCE.
THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO PREPARE STUDENTS FOR CITIZENSHIP.
WHAT’S GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS NOT ALWAYS GOOD FOR SOCIETY.
IN A CIVILISED SOCIETY, ONE MUST ALWAYS HAVE PEOPLE WHO ARE WILLING TO HELP OTHERS.
THE BUSINESSPERSON AND THE MANUFACTURER ARE MORE IMPORTANT THAN THE POLITICIAN.
ALMOST ALL POLITICIANS PROMISE ECONOMIC GROWTH, BUT WE SHOULD HEED THE WARNINGS OF ECONOMIC EXPERTS.
SOME PEOPLE ARE MORE DESERVING OF HELP THAN OTHERS.
